---
applyTo: "learning_tracking/**/*.md"
description: "Use when updating practice logs, error bank, weekly review, and mock interview tracking."
---

Practice tracking policy

- Log each attempt with enough detail to support future review.
- Record failure types by pattern, not only by problem name.
- Keep entries concise, factual, and action-oriented.
- Convert weak areas into explicit reattempt items with target dates.

Update standards

- Practice_Log.md: one row per attempt with status and time.
- Question_Bank.md: include root cause and fix strategy.
- Weekly_Review.md: identify top 3 next-focus patterns.
- Mock_Interview_Log.md: include technical gap and communication gap.
